# EZZ BILLZ

> EZZ BILLZ is a smart personal expense manager that automatically imports bills from your email, tracks spending, splits expenses, and surfaces money leaks.

EZZ BILLZ connects to Gmail (read-only) to extract bills and receipts, lets you scan or upload receipts, organizes recurring subscriptions, and provides AI-powered insights about your spending.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Log in to your EZZ BILLZ account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new EZZ BILLZ account.
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms): Terms governing use of EZZ BILLZ.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How EZZ BILLZ handles user data and Gmail access.

## Optional

- [All Bills](/expenses): Bill history (requires sign in).
- [Analytics](/analytics): Spending insights (requires sign in).
- [Subscriptions](/subscriptions): Track recurring subscriptions (requires sign in).
